spots.name: Welcome to Bronte
spots.blurb: You've reached Welcome to Bronte, a mural by Presley Rumsey. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.blurb: You've reached Bronte, a mural by Ron Cooper's BHS Art Class - 2018. A mural with various humanoid shaped figured in various colors. The letters that spell Bronte are worked in to the mural in a subtle way.
